In his last gathering, from the pulpit, the Prophet said the Ansar will decrease, and any ruler should accept the good among them and overlook their wrongdoers' faults.
The Ansar decline a land grant in Bahrain unless the emigrants get the same, and the Prophet tells them to be patient with the preference they will see after him.
Offered land in Bahrain, the Ansar refuse unless their Quraishi brothers get the same, and the Prophet tells them to be patient with the preference they will see after him.
Allah named the Ansar and brought about the day of Bu'ath so they would embrace Islam; answering their complaint over booty, the Prophet says he would take the Ansar's valley.
Love of the Ansar is a sign of faith, hatred of hypocrisy; the Prophet calls them among his most beloved, prays their followers count as Ansar, and ranks their families.
The Prophet tells the Ansar to be patient when others are preferred after him until they meet him at the Tank, and prays for the Ansar and Emigrants.
An Ansari couple go hungry to feed the Prophet's guest and a verse is revealed; the Prophet asks rulers to accept the Ansar's good and excuse their wrongdoers.
The day of Bu'ath before the mission divided the tribes and killed their nobles, easing their conversion; girls sing Ansar songs of Bu'ath on Eid, and the Prophet allows it.
Umar urges his successor to be kind to the Ansar, and an Ansari couple give the Prophet's guest their children's food, prompting a verse on preferring others.
Seeing women and children returning from a wedding, the Prophet rises and tells the Ansar they are the most beloved of all people to him.
The Prophet ranked the best Ansar families, Banu An-Najjar first, then Banu Abdil Ash-hal, Banu Al-Harith and Banu Sa'ida, adding there is good in every Ansar family.
The Prophet said the best family among the Ansar is the Banu An-Najjar.
To an Ansari woman with her children the Prophet swore three times that they were the most beloved people to him.
But for the emigration, the Prophet would have been one of the Ansar, and he would take the Ansar's valley if people took another.
The Prophet gathered the Ansar in a tent and told them to be patient until they meet Allah and His Messenger, who will be at the Kauthar.
